OTECH Wire Tags Labels Sticker PVC Self Adhesive A4 210x297mm (Tags 30Pcs/Sheet)

OTECH Colorful Labels for Cable Tags

Wire Labels (PVC) Self-Adhesive Sticker

Color: Yellow

Easy-to-Find Cables
